_meta.purpose: English wording for IRUSHY's local engine. 'frames' have 2-4 variants; the engine picks one with a seed made from the request, so the same question always gets the same wording. 'fixed' entries are single texts (button labels, notices).
rules: Plain text only. No HTML, no Markdown, no URLs.
Keep {slot} names exactly as they are; every variant of a frame must use the same slots.
IRUSHY is an AI assistant, not a human teacher. Never promise anything the website does not publish.

greeting.reply: Hello! I'm IRUSHY, an AI assistant for this website.
Hi! I'm IRUSHY, the AI assistant for TNHHSSCTA.
Hello and welcome. I'm IRUSHY, an AI assistant, not a human teacher.
greeting.offer: I can help you find pages on this site, or explain a computer-science topic. What would you like to know?
Ask me about the website, or name a topic such as number systems or Python.
I can point you to materials and pages, or explain a lesson topic step by step. What do you need?
thanks.more: Ask me anything else about the website or a topic.
If you have another question, just ask.
I'm here if you need anything else.
farewell.reply: Goodbye, and all the best with your studies.
Bye! Come back any time you need help.
Take care, and good luck with your preparation.
identity.lead: I'm IRUSHY, an AI assistant for this website. I'm not a human teacher.

identity.engine: My answers come from IRUSHY's own rule-based engine and the verified information on this site, not from an online AI service.
I answer with IRUSHY's own engine, using only the verified information on this site; nothing you type is sent to an outside AI service.
